title.zh: 工艺选择：不是所有密集图形都选 SADP
title.en: Route selection: SADP is not for every dense pattern

body.zh: 两次独立光刻与刻蚀形成交错线条：第一次形成第一组线，第二次形成第二组线，再得到交错图形。二维图形较灵活，对 overlay 更敏感，需要两套光刻/刻蚀图形。
body.en: Two independent lithography/etch cycles form interleaved lines: the first forms one set and the second forms the other. LELE is more flexible for 2D patterns, more overlay sensitive, and requires two lithography/etch patterns.

body.zh: 光刻形成 Mandrel → 沉积 Spacer 并各向异性刻蚀 → 去除 Mandrel 得到倍频线网 → Cut/Block 图形编辑。适合规则密集线网倍频，关键边由侧墙自对准，但增加沉积、刻蚀与 Cut/Block 整合。
body.en: Lithographically form mandrels → deposit spacers and anisotropically etch → remove mandrels for a doubled grid → cut/block editing. Suited to doubling regular dense grids, with self-aligned sidewall edges, but adds deposition, etch, and cut/block integration.

body.zh: 在 SADP 基础上再进行一次自对准循环：第一次形成 Spacer，第二次再次形成 Spacer，得到更高线密度。重复自对准循环使流程更长，误差传播、缺陷与成本更复杂。
body.en: Add another self-aligned cycle to SADP: first form spacers, then form spacers again for higher line density. Repeated cycles lengthen the flow and complicate error propagation, defects, and cost.

heading.zh: 04 选择轴与 05 选择逻辑

body.zh: 综合评估目标 Pitch、一维/二维图形复杂度、Cut/Block 数量、EPE 预算、材料选择性、成本与周期。二维灵活性优先则评估 LELE；规则线网与自对准关键边则评估 SADP；更高线密度且接受更长流程则评估 SAQP。
body.en: Assess target pitch, 1D/2D complexity, cut/block count, EPE budget, material selectivity, cost, and cycle time. Evaluate LELE for 2D flexibility; SADP for regular grids/self-aligned edges; SAQP for higher density when a longer flow is acceptable.

body.zh: EUV 可用于形成 Mandrel 或 Block，路线仍需按层级、图形与成本评估。工艺选择由 Pitch、图形复杂度、EPE、材料窗口与成本共同决定。
body.en: EUV can form mandrels or blocks; routes still require layer-, pattern-, and cost-specific assessment. Pitch, complexity, EPE, material window, and cost jointly determine the choice.

heading.zh: 08 量测、09 反馈、10 边界

body.zh: 反馈项目：最终 EPE/CDU、LER/LWR、缺陷、电性。动作：实验分片 → 图形与电性相关 → 决策评审。不同层级可能采用不同路线，不以单一曝光方式概括整套工艺。
body.en: Track final EPE/CDU, LER/LWR, defects, electrical properties. Actions: experimental splits → pattern/electrical correlation → decision review. Different layers may use different routes; one exposure method does not describe the whole process.
